provider.sourceUseDisposition: Use of the dataset under its documented uploader CC0 declaration for the user-approved owner-private Site import. This is not a claim of upstream PFR clearance or Stathead permission.

qualityDisposition.scope: Only24 exact original-source QB games. No repaired Sheet completeness flag is used as proof.
qualityDisposition.participation: Every selected original row has explicit positive corrected passing attempts.
qualityDisposition.derivation: Verified completed team final score0 proves twoPoint0 and offensive recoveryTD0. No yard/count/lost-fumble zero is inferred from a shutout.
qualityDisposition.missingValues: Original dataset lacks lost fumbles, two-point credits and offensive recovery TD split; raw unknowns staynull separately from two verified derived scoring zeros.
qualityDisposition.coverage: Provider-sourced nine fields with internal/rating/profile checks and selected NFL passing/rushing corroboration; not independent corroboration of every supplied numeric field.

authorization: User-approved owner-private, clearly labeled read-only test/review exposure. No normal gameplay activation or sharing change.
selectionBias: These 24 games were selected because their teams finished with 0 points; this low-scoring sample is not representative of career performances and is excluded from normal drafts, draws and seasons.
